clips.title: The story
paras: Kinelory is ready to return to Quae, and asks you to go with her to the farm. She fears the undead may harm Hillsbrad while they wait, and she needs you to see her safely back.

Kinelory is ready to act after the earlier steps of the investigation. She asks you to go with her down to the farm, then see her safely back to Quae. Anyone who cares about the people of Hillsbrad is urged to protect her.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All right, friend. I'm ready if you are.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The time for talk is done. Protect Kinelory if you care about the people of Hillsbrad at all.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done a great service for us, friend. Thank you.
I hope Kin wasn't too much of a handful down there. She's very friendly, but can be just as deadly when you're her enemy.
